notes.title: Steam Achievements and More in Update 1.7!
notes.content: [p]Update 1.7 for [i]Motherboard Under Attack[/i] has arrived with exciting new features![/p][p]You can now unlock [b]Steam achievements[/b] while defending your motherboard from relentless waves of digital viruses.[/p][p]We’ve also optimized performance and adjusted levels to make challenges more balanced and fun.[/p][p]Grab your solder, place your towers, and prove you’re the true master of electronic defense![/p]
